page.overview:
Who is Anton Zeck?

Anton Zeck, better known as Bebop, is a mutant warthog who works for the . A master thief and occasional inventor, he is capable of lifting almost anything from its possessor using his slick skills and advanced technology.

This version of Zeck is branched off from in the 2012 TV series. His history before the events of Panini comics is the same as that of his animated version.

Bebop is a thin humanoid mutant warthog with a short left tusk, long right tusk and the high-tech parts of his suit fused to his body. The top half of his high-tech suit became a vest.

Bebop makes his debut in Bad Science!. He and kidnap under the mistaken impression that he is the "smart one". Incensed at their insults to his intelligence after they learn the truth, Mikey insists that he was the one who invented the retro-mutagen that they want so badly. Mikey proceeds to create formula after formula in an attempt to prove his point. However, each formula he tests on the pair produces unpleasant results. A final explosion blows the pair through a window and they run off into the night.
